jobs.description: Amsterdam  Job Day Alert! Junior designer wanted! That's why we're organizing a Job Day for the thirteenth time on October 8 from 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM. During this day, we invite promising candidates to show what they're made of. Job description As a junior designer, you'll work on national and international wayfinding projects, conducting analyses, developing strategies, and translating these into designs. You'll use a variety of tools to do this, such as spatial adjustments, additions to a building or area, digital tools like AI, or signage. Our ideal candidate: - Wants to develop further in our specialty and has the drive to work and learn in a multidisciplinary wayfinding organization. - Has a completed relevant bachelor's or master's degree in graphic design, industrial design, service design, information design, or architecture. - Is creative, analytical, curious and critical. - Is digitally savvy: would rather build their own tool, script, or AI application to solve a problem than do it by hand. - Has an eye for detail but can also maintain a good overview. - Sees design as offering solutions: is just as happy diving into data (visitor flows, waiting times at a counter) as into a sketch. - Has strong command of Adobe Illustrator and basic knowledge of Adobe InDesign - this is a must. Experience with relevant 3D design and visualization software or AI tools is a plus. - Speaks and writes fluent Dutch and English. - Lives in the Netherlands. Job Day The morning starts at 9:30 AM with a welcome, followed by an assessment where we present you with several Mijksenaar cases. This gives us insight into your graphic, spatial, analytical, and other, sometimes surprising, skills. You'll also give a 5-minute presentation on one of the projects from your portfolio, which we'll then discuss with you. Do you enjoy working with your hands, like variety in your job, and want to see the results of your work every day? At Amtra Mobiele Ruimte, you'll work on a wide range of projects across the Benelux. One day you'll be assembling modular units on-site, the next you'll be carrying out maintenance or coordinating a team of technicians. No two days are the same. As a Service Technician / Site Supervisor, you will be responsible for assembling, dismantling, maintaining and delivering modular units at customer locations. You will work independently or together with colleagues on a variety of projects, ensuring everything is completed safely, efficiently and to a high standard. Your responsibilities include: Assembling, dismantling and maintaining modular units; Installing walls, doors, locks and fittings; Performing carpentry, sawing, painting and finishing work; Installing electrical wiring and lighting; Making units windproof and watertight; Coordinating technicians and maintenance activities on-site; Reading CAD drawings and translating them into practical execution; Managing construction and installation materials. What skills do you have? You are a practical and motivated professional who enjoys taking responsibility. You like working at different locations and get energy from hands-on technical work. What do you get in return? A gross monthly salary between €2,700 and €3,700, dependingon your experience and skills; A full-time position within a stable and growing family-owned company; A varied job with projects across the Netherlands and Belgium; Opportunities to follow technical training courses and obtain certifications; Excellent career development opportunities; Competitive primary and secondary employment conditions; A friendly and informal working environment where colleagues support each other. Amtra B.V. specialises in the rental and installation of modular units for both temporary and long-term accommodation solutions. From its Dutch branch, the company delivers projects throughout the Benelux. Amtra is part of a German family-owned business with more than 25 years of experience. Quality, teamwork and short communication lines are at the heart of the organisation. You'll join an informal team where people work hard, help each other and enjoy building impressive projects together.
